title: Agents: Hermes and Claude Code
description: Hermes and Claude Code compared on the claude_code.* metric contract. Companion to grafana.com 25255 (Claude Code Metrics (Prometheus), Rock Martel-Langlois, MIT). Generated by scripts/grafana/agents_dashboard.py in hermes-otel.

options.content: Hermes and Claude Code on one set of axes, read from the four metrics both export under Claude Code's names: `claude_code.session.count`, `claude_code.token.usage`, `claude_code.cost.usage`, `claude_code.active_time.total` (Hermes: `metric_name_compat: claude_code` in hermes-otel). **Hermes is blue, Claude Code is orange, in every panel.** Totals are `increase()` over the selected range; the time panels show the amount *in* each 5-minute bucket, not a per-hour rate. Companion to the community dashboard [Claude Code Metrics (Prometheus), grafana.com 25255](https://grafana.com/grafana/dashboards/25255-claude-code-metrics-prometheus/) by Rock Martel-Langlois (MIT), vendored next to this one; its cache-hit-ratio query is adapted here. Built by [hermes-otel](https://github.com/briancaffey/hermes-otel) (`scripts/grafana/agents_dashboard.py`).

panels.title: Sessions
panels.description: Session starts in the range (both agents). `increase(claude_code_session_count_total)`.

panels.title: Spend
panels.description: Each agent's own price for its API calls. Hermes: `agent.usage_pricing`; Claude Code: its client-side estimate.

panels.title: Active time
panels.description: Seconds the agents were working (`type=cli`): a Hermes turn's wall-clock, Claude Code's tool and response time. Claude Code's `user` typing time is excluded so the two compare.

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: cacheRead / (cacheRead + cacheCreation + input), the same definition for both agents (query adapted from grafana.com 25255).

panels.title: Hermes and Claude Code, side by side
By agent
panels.description: Each bar is scaled to its column's largest value. Cache hit = cacheRead / (cacheRead + cacheCreation + input).

targets.expr: sum by (service_name) (increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{service_name=~"$agent", model=~"$model", type="cacheRead"}[$__range])) / sum by (service_name) (increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{service_name=~"$agent", model=~"$model", type=~"cacheRead|cacheCreation|input"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Tokens by type
panels.description: Stacked: input (uncached prompt), output, cacheRead, cacheCreation.

panels.title: Cache hit ratio by agent
panels.description: Per bucket; a bucket with no prompt tokens leaves a gap.

targets.expr: sum by (service_name) (increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{service_name=~"$agent", model=~"$model", type="cacheRead"}[$__interval])) / sum by (service_name) (increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{service_name=~"$agent", model=~"$model", type=~"cacheRead|cacheCreation|input"}[$__interval]))

sum by (service_name, model) (increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{service_name=~"$agent", model=~"$model", type="cacheRead"}[$__range])) / sum by (service_name, model) (increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{service_name=~"$agent", model=~"$model", type=~"cacheRead|cacheCreation|input"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Most expensive sessions
panels.description: Needs `session.id` on the metrics: Claude Code sends it by default, Hermes with `metric_name_compat_session_id: true`. Without it an agent is one row.

panels.title: By query source
panels.description: `main` is the agent loop, `subagent` a delegated child, `auxiliary` the calls made on the agent's behalf (titles, compaction, ...). The same label and values in both tools.
